name: GuidingCenter (numpy)
description:
Guiding-centre (5D drift-kinetic) test particles in a homogeneous slab, used as the
NumPy-vs-CuPy backend comparison case. Its whole propagator stack is CUDA-ported and it
has no FEEC field solve, so wall-clock time is dominated by the particle kernels the GPU
port targets.

custom_commands: echo "Running profiling case: guidingcenter_numpy_vs_cupy (1 MPI ranks)"
echo "Description: GuidingCenter particles on a cube, run once on NumPy and once on CuPy."
echo "Physics problem: Guiding-centre drift-kinetic particle motion; the particle-push hot loop common to all PIC/drift-kinetic models."
echo "Completed profiling case: guidingcenter_numpy_vs_cupy (1 MPI ranks)"
